reason: The README shows this plugin is a UI theme/presentation enhancement for DeepSeek Harness that discovers Settings and sidebar targets and lets users override or reset their icons, with a dedicated interface for selecting, searching, and managing those icon mappings.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness 的设置页与侧边栏进行图标定制，通过发现目标项并提供可搜索的选择器与恢复操作，让用户配置界面图标主题。
summaries.en: This plugin customizes DeepSeek Harness settings and sidebar icons, discovering target entries and providing a searchable picker to assign and reset icon mappings in the plugin's settings UI.

capabilities: Replaces icons for DeepSeek Harness settings sections and sidebar actions with user-selected glyphs
Presents a searchable picker to choose, filter, and reset icon mappings from within plugin settings
Persists icon override mappings by stable IDs and restores host SVGs/markers on unload

reasons.code: "Automatic, coherent, and user-customizable icons for DeepSeek Harness Settings and sidebar actions."
"The page lists every discovered target... Search by feature name, ID, or icon; choose a glyph; or restore one/all targets to automatic behavior."
"The plugin restores every host SVG and removes all owned DOM markers and styles on unload."
